integrity: Proof gives all-parameter results. Finite direct and lifted checks are corroborative, not a proof of the infinite family. No independent audit or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to three-color, threshold-one synchronous CCA on a clique with rooted trees attached to its vertices. Does not classify arbitrary cyclic cores, multi-block cacti, other color counts or first-entry distributions within each basin. The general synchronization/diameter theorem is prior work. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent treatments.
title: Tree-graft invariance and two competing sharp clocks in three-color cyclic dynamics
